mentions.name: Alice in Wonderland SQL Tutorial
mentions.description: This is a free, interactive SQL tutorial themed around Alice in Wonderland that aims to bring learners up to the level of a data analyst. It emphasizes unconventional lesson scaffolding, introducing concepts in small bites (e.g., withholding the concept of tables until later lessons) before introducing big concepts. A beta version is planned for release soon.
mentions.problem: Most SQL courses handle lesson scaffolding poorly, and AI tools are not great with lesson scaffolding either, overwhelming learners by introducing too much at once.
mentions.audience: People who need to learn SQL for various reasons, with the goal of reaching data-analyst level.
mentions.source_excerpt: A free interactive SQL tutorial that will get to the level of being a data analyst. It's Alice in Wonderland themed.
